capabilities: Upload pasted or dragged images to a WebDAV server and insert preview links
Download, delete and rename remote images from note context menus
Batch upload and download all images across the vault, folders or single files
Upload and download PDFs with optional dummy PDF files for preview
Write a log file of batch upload and download results
extras: The README warns that batch upload/download features have not been thoroughly tested and advises backing up the vault first. Image preview handling differs from Obsidian's default and may fail in reading mode or image properties; the README documents an Nginx configuration to allow anonymous image access instead.
intentEvidence: primarily written for my personal use to replace the image-auto-upload plugin, due to it requires running an additional PicGo locally
motivation: The author wrote it for personal use to replace the image-auto-upload plugin, which required running PicGo locally and could not upload images for an entire vault of thousands of notes.
problem: Obsidian stores images as local files, so vaults grow large and images are not available from other devices unless a remote storage workflow is set up.
